definitions.explanation: The corner-shaped brackets 「 」 used in Japanese writing to mark quoted speech, titles, or a word being singled out. Double ones 『 』 mark a quotation inside a quotation or the title of a book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉤括弧|かぎかっこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。
examples.english: Dialogue is enclosed in corner quotation marks.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{題名|だいめい}→題名：03421_daimei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧{鉤括弧|かぎかっこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Double corner brackets are used for book titles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引用|いんよう}した→引用する：26928_inyousuru⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧{鉤括弧|かぎかっこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please always put the quoted parts inside corner quotation marks.

notes:
Often written in kana, かぎかっこ or カギカッコ. In speech people often just say かっこ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉤括弧|かぎかっこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to enclose in corner brackets
- {鉤括弧|かぎかっこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put inside corner brackets
- ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧{鉤括弧|かぎかっこ}: double corner brackets 『 』

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{括弧|かっこ}→括弧：00151_kakko⟧: brackets in general
- ⟦{句読点|くとうてん}→句読点：08650_kutouten⟧: punctuation marks
